item.title: Meet an Employee Owner: Scott Donovan
item.description: More than 11,000 authors have trusted us with their books, and for good reason: our employee owners bring a rare level of care to every project. Our new Meet an Employee Owner series introduces you to some of the amazing individuals working here at FriesenPress. In our first feature, we chat with Publishing Consultant Scott Donovan!

item.title: 2025 Book Cover Showcase: A Celebration of FriesenPress Design Excellence
item.description: Our authors brought an incredible range of stories to life this year, and our design team matched that creativity with some truly stunning covers. Welcome to the 2025 Book Cover Showcase — a celebratory look back at some of the excellent designs that captured our imaginations this past year.

item.title: Our Top Blog Posts of 2025
item.description: As 2025 comes to a close, we’re revisiting our most impactful blog posts of the year—the ones packed with insights, motivation, and guidance to help writers take their next steps. To help you along your publishing journey in the new year and beyond, we’ve put them together in one big go-to collection.

item.title: Reach the Summit: Your Guide to Self-Publishing in 2026
item.description: Looking to reach the peak of publishing in the New Year? Watch the full replay (with transcript) of our free webinar with FriesenPress’s Bret Newton, who provides your guide to self-publishing in 2026 — from knowing when it’s time to stop writing to determining the services you’ll need.

item.title: How to Identify and Protect Yourself from Scams After Publication
item.description: Too good to be true? It probably is. Before you get swept up in the excitement, make sure you know the warning signs of post-publication scams—and consider our practical tips for protecting yourself (and your book).

item.title: Meet an Employee Owner: Natasha
item.description: Our Meet an Employee Owner series gives us the chance to introduce some of the incredible people behind the work we do. In this edition, we chat with Book Promotions Specialist Natasha Kelly about her favourite authors, book promotion advice, what it means to be an employee-owner, and much more.

item.title: New Year, New Book: Writing Advice for 2026
item.description: Is 2026 the year you finally write your book? Watch the full replay (with transcript) of our free webinar with FriesenPress’s Scott Donovan and learn how to turn your writing goals into something real this year.

item.title: 4 Strategies for Quelling Publishing Anxiety
item.description: Publishing your story and sharing it with the world takes courage. Fear or self-doubt can easily hold you back. The world needs your voice. That's why we're sharing 4 mindset shifts to help you finally share your book with the world.

item.title: How Romance Tropes Can Help Readers Fall in Love with Your Book
item.description: Romance tropes have taken the book world by storm — from authors listing them in blurbs to readers shopping by trope at retailers like Indigo. FriesenPress employee-owner Natasha Kelly shows how you can use romance tropes in your marketing to get readers to fall in love with your book.

item.title: More Than Art: A Book Marketer’s Perspective on Cover Design
item.description: A beautiful cover is great, but your cover's number 1 role is always marketing. Watch the full replay (with transcript) of our free webinar with FriesenPress’s Rebekah Caris and learn how to make the right design choices for a cover that truly sells your book.
